bio: A restaurant with cult status! This smart beach cabin is a much sought-after place to eat. It takes five minutes to reach it on foot through the dunes – or you can use the shuttle service. Fancy a Sansibar classic such as rice pudding with red fruit jelly? Or perhaps you'd prefer something more sophisticated? Superb wine list. No reservations taken at lunchtime. There is a playground for children next to the restaurant....
